vb5:1.2: cakkhundriyaṃ sotindriyaṃ ghānindriyaṃ jivhindriyaṃ kāyindriyaṃ manindriyaṃ itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ sukhindriyaṃ dukkhindriyaṃ somanassindriyaṃ domanassindriyaṃ upekhindriyaṃ saddhindriyaṃ viriyindriyaṃ satindriyaṃ samādhindriyaṃ paññindriyaṃ anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ aññindriyaṃ aññātāvindriyaṃ.
vb5:2.2: Yaṃ cakkhuṃ catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya pasādo . . . pe . . . suñño gāmo p' eso:
vb5:3.5: Yo kāyo catunnaṃ mahābhūtānaṃ upādāya pasādo . . . pe . . . suñño gāmo p' eso:
vb5:9.2: Itthiyā itthiliṅgaṃ itthinimittaṃ itthikuttaṃ itthākappo itthittaṃ itthibhāvo:
vb5:10.2: Purisassa purisaliṅgaṃ purisanimittaṃ purisakuttaṃ purisākappo purisattaṃ purisabhāvo:
vb5:11.3: atthi rūpaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ, atthi arūpaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ.
vb5:12.2: Yo tesaṃ rūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu ṭhiti yapanā yāpanā iriyanā vattanā pālanā jīvitaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ:
vb5:13.2: Yo tesaṃ arūpīnaṃ dhammānaṃ āyu ṭhiti yapanā yāpanā iriyanā vattanā pālanā jīvitaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ:
vb5:14.2: Yaṃ kāyikaṃ sātaṃ kāyikaṃ sukhaṃ kāyasamphassajaṃ sātaṃ sukhaṃ vedayitaṃ kāyasamphassajā sātā sukhā vedanā:
vb5:15.2: Yaṃ kāyikaṃ asātaṃ kāyikaṃ dukkhaṃ kāyasamphassajaṃ asātaṃ dukkhaṃ vedayitaṃ kāyasamphassajā asātā dukkhā vedanā:
vb5:16.2: Yaṃ cetasikaṃ sātaṃ cetasikaṃ sukhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ sātaṃ sukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā sātā sukhā vedanā:
vb5:17.2: Yo cetasikaṃ asātaṃ cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ asātaṃ dukkhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā asātā dukkhā vedanā:
vb5:18.2: Yaṃ cetasikaṃ neva-sātaṃ-nāsātaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ adukkhamasukhaṃ vedayitaṃ cetosamphassajā adukkhamasukhā vedanā:
vb5:19.2: Yā saddhā saddahanā okappanā abhippasādo saddhā saddhindriyaṃ saddhābalaṃ:
vb5:20.2: Yo cetasiko viriyārambho nikkamo parakkamo uyyāmo vāyāmo ussāho ussoḷhi thāmo dhiti asithilaparakkamatā anikkhittachandatā anikkhittadhuratā dhurasampaggāho viriyaṃ viriyindriyaṃ viriyabalaṃ sammāvāyāmo:
vb5:21.2: Yā sati anussati paṭissati sati saraṇatā dhāraṇatā apilāpanatā asamussanatā sati satindriyaṃ satibalaṃ sammāsati:
vb5:22.2: Yā cittassa ṭhiti saṇṭhiti aviṭṭhiti avisāhāro avikkhepo avisāhaṭamānasatā samatho samādhindriyaṃ samādhibalaṃ sammāsamādhi:
vb5:23.2: Yā paññā pajānanā vicayo pavicayo . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi:
vb5:24.2: Ya tesaṃ dhammānaṃ aññātānaṃ adiṭṭhānaṃ appattānaṃ aviditānaṃ asacchikatānaṃ sacchikiriyāya paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb5:25.2: Yā tesaṃ dhammānaṃ ñātānaṃ diṭṭhānaṃ pattānaṃ viditānaṃ sacchikatānaṃ sacchikiriyāya paññā pajānanā . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb5:26.2: Yā tesaṃ aññātāvīnaṃ dhammānaṃ aññā paññā pajānana . . . pe . . . amoho dhammavicayo sammādiṭṭhi dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgo maggaṅgaṃ maggapariyāpannaṃ:
vb5:28.2: cakkhundriyaṃ sotindriyaṃ ghānindriyaṃ jivhindriyaṃ kāyindriyaṃ manindriyaṃ itthindriyaṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ sukhindriyaṃ dukkhindriyaṃ somanassindriyaṃ domanassindriyaṃ upekhindriyaṃ saddhindriyaṃ viriyindriyaṃ satindriyaṃ samādhindriyaṃ paññindriyaṃ anaññātaññassāmītindriyaṃ aññindriyaṃ aññātāvindriyaṃ.

vb5:73.10: siyā na vattabbā upādāniyā ceva no ca upādānā ti.
vb5:74.1: Soḷasindriyā na vattabbā upādānā ceva upādānasampayuttā cāti pi upādānasampayuttā ceva no ca upādānā ti pi;
vb5:74.2: cha indriyā na vattabbā upādānā ceva upādānasampayuttā cāti siyā upādānasampayuttā ceva no ca upādānā siyā na vattabbā upādānasampayuttā ceva no ca upādānā ti.
vb5:74.6: cha indriyā siyā upādānavippayutta-upādāniyā siyā upādānavippayutta-anupādāniyā siyā na vattabbā upādānavippayutta-upādāniyā ti pi upādānavippayutta-anupādāniyā ti pi.
vb5:75.7: cha indriyā siyā saṅkiliṭṭhā siyā asaṅkiliṭṭhā.
vb5:75.10: cha indriyā siyā kilesasampayuttā siyā kilesavippayuttā.
vb5:75.11: Dasindriyā na vattabbā kilesā ceva saṅkilesikā cāti saṅkilesikā ceva no ca kilesā;
vb5:75.12: tīṇindriyā na vattabbā kilesā ceva saṅkilesikā cāti pi saṅkilesikā ceva no ca kilesā ti pi;
vb5:75.13: navindriyā na vattabbā kilesā ceva saṅkilesikā cāti siyā saṅkilesikā ceva no ca kilesā siyā na vattabbā saṅkilesikā ceva no ca kilesikā ti.
vb5:76.1: Paṇṇarasindriyā no vattabbā kilesā ceva saṅkiliṭṭhā cāti pi saṅkiliṭṭhā ceva no ca kilesā ti pi;
vb5:76.2: domanassindriyaṃ na vattabbaṃ kileso ceva saṅkiliṭṭhañ cāti saṅkiliṭṭhañ ceva no ca kileso;
vb5:76.3: cha indriyā na vattabbā kilesā ceva saṅkiliṭṭhā cāti siyā saṅkiliṭṭhā ceva no ca kilesā siyā na vattabbā saṅkiliṭṭhā ceva no ca kilesā ti.
vb5:77.1: Paṇṇarasindriyā na vattabbā kilesā ceva kilesasampayuttā cāti pi kilesasampayuttā ceva no ca kilesā ti pi;
vb5:77.2: domanassindriyaṃ na vattabbaṃ kileso ceva kilesasampayuttañ cāti kilesasampayuttañ ceva no ca kileso;
vb5:77.3: cha indriyā na vattabbā kilesā ceva kilesasampayuttā cāti siyā kilesasampayuttā ceva no ca kilesā siyā na vattabbā kilesasampayuttā ceva no ca kilesā ti.
vb5:77.6: domanassindriyaṃ na vattabbaṃ kilesavippayutta-saṅkilesikan ti pi kilesavippayutta-asaṅkilesikan ti pi;
vb5:77.8: cha indriyā siyā kilesavippayutta-saṅkilesikā siyā kilesa-vippayutta-asaṅkilesikā siyā na vattabbā kilesavippayutta-saṅkilesikā cāti pi kilesavippayutta-asaṅkilesikā cāti pi.
vb5:78.2: sattindriyā siyā dassanena pahātabbā siyā na dassanena pahātabbā.
vb5:78.4: sattindriyā siyā bhāvanāya pahātabbā siyā na bhāvanāya pahātabbā.
vb5:78.6: sattindriyā siyā dassanena pahātabbahetukā siyā na dassanena pahātabbahetukā.
vb5:78.8: sattindriyā siyā bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā siyā na bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukā.
vb5:79.10: ekādasindriyā siyā pītisahagatā siyā na pītisahagatā.
vb5:79.12: dasindriyā siyā sukhasahagatā siyā na sukhasahagatā.
vb5:79.14: dasindriyā siyā upekhāsahagatā siyā na upekhāsahagatā.
vb5:80.3: navindriyā siyā kāmāvacarā siyā na kāmāvacarā.
vb5:80.5: navindriyā siyā rūpāvacarā siyā na rūpāvacarā.
vb5:80.7: aṭṭhindriyā siyā arūpāvacarā siyā na arūpāvacarā.
vb5:80.22: cha indriyā siyā saraṇā siyā araṇā ti.
